The '''Theed Royal Library''' was a [[Library/Legends|library]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was turned into a war room during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==History==
Constructed in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the Royal Library served the citizens of Naboo as a haven of learning.<ref name="Strategy guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Royal Library was turned into a war room by the droids. Two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']] can be played with one or two characters; these characters are [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]. Any character can be selected from the loading screen for any of the game's 10 missions. This article assumes the selection of Jinn and Kenobi, per their appearance in Episode I.</ref> [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Capture of Theed/Legends|passed by the library]] on their way to rescue the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from being taken to the [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] camps. Through their efforts, the Queen was able to escape offworld and break the Federation's [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]].<ref name="SW:JPB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Theed Royal Library appears in the background of the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]'' in the game's third mission.
